Markus,

We started seeing severe p95/p99 spikes and a small number of 502 errors from the Hosted API on our /v1/generate route starting ~07:50 PDT. Throughput dropped ~30% and several background jobs retried. Attached a small log snippet (spike_logs_0912.txt).

Thanks,

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: High p99 latency on /generate this morning

Quick tech summary after triage:
- Observed a "bootstorm" pattern: ~120 concurrent new session startups routed to Skyward's dedicated route between 07:45-07:58. Autoscaler proceeded to spin up ~48 GPU workers.
- Median container start = 450ms, but GPU model init (cold load + mmap) shows a heavy tail: 400ms-1.1s. Combined start-to-first-token correlates with customer p95/p99 spikes.
- We identified a recent change (deploy 2027-09-11 23:40 UTC) to the memory-mapping path used by the compiler that adds roughly 200-350ms on worst paths when many inits occur simultaneously. This reproduces in staging for concurrent cold starts.
- Error 502s are likely request timeouts during model load when retry/backpressure intersects with backend proxies.

Immediate recommended actions:
A) Roll back the mmap change in the 23:40 deploy (fastest mitigation).
B) Increase pre-warm pool size for Skyward's route from 2 -> 6 for the next 3 hours to absorb traffic while rollback is validated.
C) Add a short-term per-route admission control (token-bucket) to smooth concurrent session bursts.

I'll open a rollback PR and a hotfix for runtime to avoid mmap path on cold init. ETA for rollback to staging: 20m; prod rollback if validated: +30m.

Links: https://observability.redwood.internal/dashboards/hostedapi/skyward/2027-09-12 (latency heatmap), PDINC-4782

-Aditya
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Ben — thanks for the report and the logs. Short update from our side: engineering has identified a likely regression introduced in last night's runtime deploy that amplifies cold-start tail latency when many instances initialize concurrently. We propose the following immediate mitigations we can apply with your sign-off:

1) Temporarily increase your route's pre-warm capacity to 6 instances for the next 3 hours (we'll monitor and revert).
2) Apply a soft admission control to smooth incoming bursts for the next 60 minutes.
3) We'll rollback the specific mmap change and validate that rollback in staging before promoting.

If you approve 1+2 we can push the config change in ~15 minutes. We will not restart any of your running jobs without explicit approval.

Apologies for the impact — we understand the production sensitivity. I'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until resolved.

Grace O'Connor
